mapper.sql: r.user_id as userId, count(*) as reportRecordCount, count(distinct date_format(r.create_time, '%Y-%m')) as activeMonths, count(distinct r.process_id) as processCount, count(distinct r.item_code) as productCount, min(r.create_time) as firstReportTime, max(r.create_time) as lastReportTime
mapper.select: select from pro_reporting_work r group by r.user_id order by lastReportTime desc, r.user_id asc
select count(distinct r.user_id) from pro_reporting_work r
select from pro_reporting_work r group by r.user_id

select r.process_id as processId, max(r.process_code) as processCode, max(r.process_name) as processName, count(*) as reportRecordCount, count(distinct date_format(r.create_time, '%Y-%m')) as activeMonths, count(distinct r.item_code) as productCount, count(distinct r.workorder_code) as workorderCount, max(r.create_time) as lastReportTime from pro_reporting_work r group by r.process_id order by lastReportTime desc, r.process_id asc

select r.item_code as itemCode, max(r.item_name) as itemName, count(*) as reportRecordCount, count(distinct date_format(r.create_time, '%Y-%m')) as activeMonths, count(distinct r.process_id) as processCount, max(r.create_time) as lastReportTime from pro_reporting_work r group by r.item_code order by lastReportTime desc, r.item_code asc

select date_format(r.create_time, '%Y-%m') as month, count(distinct date(r.create_time)) as activeDayCount, count(*) as reportRecordCount, count(distinct r.process_id) as processCount, count(distinct r.item_code) as productCount from pro_reporting_work r group by date_format(r.create_time, '%Y-%m') order by month asc

select r.record_id recordId,r.user_id userId,r.create_time createTime,r.user_name userName,r.create_by createBy, r.reporting_work_type reportingWorkType,r.process_code processCode,r.process_name processName, r.item_code itemCode,r.item_name itemName,r.unit_of_measure unitOfMeasure,r.reporting_work_quantity reportingWorkQuantity from pro_reporting_work r order by r.create_time desc,r.record_id desc
